items.title: Albert "June" Gardner Interview, 1996-04-17
items.q: I hear something by James Black with someone else, Smokey, you know, Blackwell. And I say that's a New Orleans drummer.

ctx.x: It's hard. You walk in Chicago.

What's that? It's a certain, well you can't write it, you know. It's hard to describe. It's more of a feeling I would think. You know, because you can hear something and you say, hey that's a New Orleans piece. It's just like the second line, I don't want to wear that out, but you know when you hear a second line piece. A lot of times, Idris could be playing and I say, Idris, that's a New Orleans drummer. I hear something by James Black with someone else, Smokey, you know, Blackwell. And I say that's a New…
